title: Missing "Next Page" references for "Enahanced Tags", " HTTP Methods" and " Sequential Media Types  OpenAPI 3.2+"

raw.title: Missing "Next Page" references for "Enahanced Tags", " HTTP Methods" and " Sequential Media Types  OpenAPI 3.2+"
raw.body: Hello, I was reading the documentation when I noticed some missing "next page" references - `Describing API Security` > `Enhanced Tags` - `Enhanced Tags` > `HTTP Methods` - `HTTP Methods` > `Sequential Media Types` #### Current [API Servers Page](https://learn.openapis.org/specification/servers.html) points to [Describe API Security](https://learn.openapis.org/specification/security) I have fixed this locally but wanted to check with the maintainers before raising a PR. If this is a helpful change, I can raise the PR. Here's what my PR would add #### [Describing API Security](https://learn.openapis.org/specification/security.html) #### [Enhanced Tags](https://learn.openapis.org/specification/tags.html) #### [HTTP Methods](https://learn.openapis.org/specification/http-methods.html)
